blocks.text: A duelist's weapon — win fights one opponent at a time through precise single-target bursts and timed defense. Precision here is **timing**, not luck: no crits, no armor-piercing — just reading the fight and hitting the beat.
**Status:** design locked, numbers in tuning. One active skill is still being finalized. Below are the in-game skill entries.
Every Sword rolls its kit from this pool: **1 ultimate + a few actives + a few passives**.

blocks.subtitle: One per Sword. Charge in combat, ~40 MP to unleash.

skills.name: Deathblow
skills.effect: Consumes all Momentum. Deals **600% Attack**, **+40% per stack** consumed. Without Momentum, deals a flat **600% Attack**.

skills.name: Bladedance
skills.effect: Strikes the target **~2×/sec for 100% Attack** over **8s**; higher Attack Speed adds strikes. Grants full **invulnerability to all damage — poison, bleed and burn included — for the duration**.

skills.name: Retribution
skills.effect: Cashes the damage **Brace** is holding: strikes for **250% of the banked total** and **erases the debt** — you never pay what you release. Also recovers **50% of the banked total** as HP. Requires Brace.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.effect: Dashes to the target and strikes for **100% Attack**. With **Lock Blades**, also grants **5 charges**.

skills.name: Brace
skills.flavor: Take it now, pay it later.
skills.effect: Arms **5 charges** for **4s**. Each charge holds back one incoming hit — that damage is **banked** instead of costing you health. When the window ends, everything banked lands at once. A delay, not a save: **Retribution** is the only way out of the bill.

skills.name: Parry
skills.effect: Fully blocks the next hit (**0 damage**) and is spent by it.

skills.name: Guard Stance
skills.effect: Reduces damage taken by **50%** for **5s**.

skills.name: Overclock
skills.effect: Grants **+30% Attack Speed** for **8s** and inflicts **2× damage taken** for **3s**. Bladedance's invulnerability negates the drawback; Retribution banks the doubled damage.

skills.name: Feint
skills.effect: A quick strike. Against an enemy mid-wind-up, **interrupts and staggers** the attack.

skills.name: Committed Strike
skills.effect: Charges a heavy overhead slash, then lands the Sword's strongest non-ultimate hit.

skills.name: Disarm
skills.effect: Strikes the target, **weakening its next attack**.

skills.name: Onslaught
skills.effect: A rapid sequence of **basic attacks**. Each hit grants Momentum and triggers all on-basic-attack effects.

blocks.text: *One more active is still being designed.*

blocks.subtitle: Always active — no button to press.

skills.name: Momentum
skills.effect: Each basic attack grants **+1 Momentum**. Every stack adds **~3% to all damage**. Stacks expire one at a time. Deathblow consumes all stacks.

skills.name: Perfect Form
skills.effect: Every **3 consecutive hits on the same target** grant **+1 Momentum** and slow Momentum decay. Missing or switching targets resets the streak.

skills.name: Encore
skills.effect: A kill during Bladedance **extends the storm**.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.effect: *Being redesigned — its old form depended on Retribution's auto-parry chain, which no longer exists.*

skills.name: Composure
skills.effect: After a successful Parry, the **next skill costs 0 MP**.

skills.name: Unwavering
skills.effect: During Guard Stance, grants immunity to **knockback and stagger**.

skills.name: Opening
skills.effect: A successful **Feint** may create an **Opening**. Your next damaging strike consumes it to deal **200% Attack**.

skills.name: Pressure
skills.effect: Consecutive hits on the same target **delay its health regeneration**.

skills.name: Lock Blades
skills.effect: Casting Lunge grants **5 charges**, each lasting **5s** and granting **+5% Attack Speed** while held. Each hit you land spends one to **automatically lunge** at the target again. Auto-lunges don't spend further charges of their own. With no charges left, nothing fires. Requires Lunge.
